name: Acorn Tower
desc: Shoots acorns at enemies near it
_note_arrows: 23 Nov 2026: full-circle yaw and vertical crossbow aim, a drawn bowstring and a visibly loaded enlarged Twig Bow arrow. All five existing tower models remain; the former fixed acorn is removed and the native string split out for animation. Arrows fly straight with swept collision and a readable trail. Damage/cadence/prices are retained; range grows 5/6/7/8/9 m. Arrow scale and tip/fletching colours change with every level. Tower base stays fixed.
_note: Phase G2: a knocked-down tower can be repaired on the spot. Since 21 Nov 2026 that repair costs what 'Mend the defences' asks for the tower (leaves only): during the missions `piece` x raid.repair_share x the share it is missing (at least 5), after them gloom_raids.repair's mend rule. repair_share and repair_leaves_per_timber here are no longer read (kept for reference).
